-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat
    task.wait()
until game:IsLoaded() and game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if type(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop)
end
local Connections = {}
local function track(connection)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = connection
    return connection
end
local function connect(signal, callback)
    return track(signal:Connect(callback))
end
local State = {
    Running = true,
    GunAimV2 = true,
    GunRageMode = false,
    GunAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAim = true,
    KnifeAimV2 = false,
    KnifeRageMode = false,
    KnifeAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAimFOV = 220,
    RoundCombatSuspended = true,
    WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0,
}
local BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
local OriginalWorkspaceNamecall
local OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction
local WeaponServiceMouseRaw
local WeaponServiceTargetRaw
local getIgnoredParts
local function safeRequire(module)
    if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
    return ok and value or nil
end
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules", 15)
local CurrentRoundClient = modules and safeRequire(modules:WaitForChild("CurrentRoundClient", 15))
local clientServices = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 15)
local WeaponService = clientServices and safeRequire(clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 15))
local OriginalWeaponService = {}
if type(WeaponService) == "table" then
    OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
    OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition = WeaponService.GetTargetPosition
end
local function premiumGunAimIsEnabled() return false end
local function getGunRageShotCFrames() return nil, nil, nil end
local function isKnifeWallBangRay() return false end
local function getPremiumGunAimCFrame() return nil, nil, nil end

-- Round data
local function getRoundDataRemote()
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
    local remote = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("GetCurrentPlayerData")
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then return remote end
    return nil
end
local function getRoundData()
    if type(CurrentRoundClient) == "table" then
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) == "table" and next(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) then return CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData end
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData)
            if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
        end
    end
    local remote = getRoundDataRemote()
    if remote then
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return remote:InvokeServer()
        end)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
    end
    return {}
end
local function hasWeaponTool(player, weapon)
    for _, container in ipairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
                    if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                            or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function hasEquippedWeapon(weapon)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                    or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                return true
            end
            if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
    local data = playerData[player.Name]
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Knife") then return "Murderer", data end
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Gun") then return "Sheriff", data end
    if type(data) == "table" and data.Dead ~= true and type(data.Role) == "string" then return data.Role, data end
    return nil, data
end
local function getRoundIntel()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local intel = { Murderer = {}, Sheriff = {}, Innocent = {}, }
    local alive = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local role, data = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        local isAlive = type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then isAlive = false end
        if role == "Hero" then role = "Sheriff" end
        if isAlive then
            alive += 1
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Innocent" then
                table.insert(intel[role], player.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    return intel, alive
end
local function isPlaying()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local localData = playerData[LocalPlayer.Name]
    if type(localData) == "table" and localData.Dead == true then return false end
    if hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Gun") or hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Knife") then return true end
    if type(localData) == "table" then
        local role = localData.Role
        if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent" then return true end
    end
    local aliveAttribute = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive")
    if aliveAttribute ~= nil then return aliveAttribute == true end
    return humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getRoot()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getInstanceRoot(instance)
    if not instance then return nil end
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then return instance end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then return instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    if instance:IsA("Tool") then return instance:FindFirstChild("Handle") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
            if role == "Murderer" then return player end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function playerIsAlive(player, playerData)
    if not player or not player.Character then return false end
    local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local data = playerData and playerData[player.Name]
    return type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
end
local getIgnoredParts
local function getCharacterKnifeAimPart(character, mode)
    if not character then return nil end
    if mode == "Torso" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head") or getInstanceRoot(character)
    end
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or getInstanceRoot(character)
end
local function getCrosshair()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return nil end
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local x = mouseLocation.X
    local y = mouseLocation.Y
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local mouseLock = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("MouseLock")
    if mouseLock and mouseLock:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true and UserInputService.PreferredInput ~= Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
        local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
        x = viewportSize.X / 2
        y = viewportSize.Y / 2
    end
    return Vector2.new(x, y)
end
local function hasClearShot(origin, targetPart)
    if not origin or not targetPart then return false end
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.1 then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = getIgnoredParts()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    if not ok then return false end
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

-- Gun
local function getGunTarget(allowWalls)
    local murderer = findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if not murderer or not playerIsAlive(murderer, playerData) or not murderer.Character then return nil, nil, nil end
    local character = murderer.Character
    local preferred
    if State.GunAimTargetPart == "Torso" then
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Head"), }
    else
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), }
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position or (root and root.Position)
    local targetPart
    for _, part in ipairs(preferred) do
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if allowWalls or not origin or hasClearShot(origin, part) then
                targetPart = part
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not targetPart then return nil, murderer, nil end
    local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 120 end
    local distance = root and (targetPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local leadTime = math.clamp(0.035 + distance / 2200, 0.035, 0.09)
    local predicted = targetPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(predicted), murderer, targetPart
end
local KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
local KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0

-- Knife
local function getKnifeTarget(requireVisible)
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local aimPoint = getCrosshair()
    if not root or not camera or not aimPoint then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local viewOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local now = os.clock()
    local fov = math.max(40, tonumber(State.KnifeAimFOV) or 220)
    local function evaluate(player, sticky)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not playerIsAlive(player, playerData) or not player.Character then return nil end
        local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        if role == "Murderer" then return nil end
        local part = getCharacterKnifeAimPart( player.Character, State.KnifeAimTargetPart )
        if not part then return nil end
        local screenPosition, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - aimPoint).Magnitude
        local allowedFov = sticky and (fov * 1.25) or fov
        if screenDistance > allowedFov then return nil end
        if requireVisible and not hasClearShot(viewOrigin, part) then return nil end
        local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        return part, screenDistance + distance * 0.025, distance
    end
    if KnifeAimStickyPlayer and now <= KnifeAimStickyUntil then
        local part, _, distance = evaluate(KnifeAimStickyPlayer, true)
        if part then
            local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
            local leadTime = math.clamp(distance / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
            return CFrame.new(part.Position + velocity * leadTime), KnifeAimStickyPlayer, part
        end
    end
    local bestTarget
    local bestPart
    local bestDistance
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local part, score, distance = evaluate(player, false)
        if part and score < bestScore then
            bestTarget = player
            bestPart = part
            bestDistance = distance
            bestScore = score
        end
    end
    if not bestTarget or not bestPart then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    KnifeAimStickyPlayer = bestTarget
    KnifeAimStickyUntil = now + 0.28
    local velocity = bestPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
    local leadTime = math.clamp((bestDistance or 0) / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
    local targetPosition = bestPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(targetPosition), bestTarget, bestPart
end
function getIgnoredParts()
    local ignored = {}
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        table.insert(ignored, character)
    end
    for _, instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
        table.insert(ignored, instance)
    end
    return ignored
end
local function raycastForGunAimV2(origin, direction, params)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if type(OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction) == "function" then
            return OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction( workspace, origin, direction, params )
        end
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    return ok and result or nil
end
local function isWeaponRay(origin, direction)
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return false end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude < 297 or magnitude > 303 then return false end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end
    if (origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 3.5 then return false end
    if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then
        local ok, caller = pcall(getcallingscript)
        if ok and typeof(caller) == "Instance" then
            local path = string.lower(caller:GetFullName())
            if string.find(path, "camera", 1, true) or string.find(path, "zoom", 1, true) or string.find(path, "occlusion", 1, true) then
                return false
            end
            if string.find(path, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(path, "weapon", 1, true) or string.find(path, "shoot", 1, true)
                or string.find(path, "knife", 1, true) or string.find(path, "projectile", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function raycastToTarget(targetPart)
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then return nil end
    local targetCharacter = targetPart.Parent
    local targetPosition = targetPart.Position
    local ignored = getIgnoredParts()
    for _, child in ipairs(targetCharacter:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(ignored, child)
        end
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local right = targetPart.CFrame.RightVector
    local forward = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
    local offsets = { -forward * 5, forward * 5, right * 5, -right * 5, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), }
    for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
        local origin = targetPosition + offset
        local direction = targetPosition - origin
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local ok, result = pcall(raycastForGunAimV2, origin, direction, params )
            if ok and result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter) then return result end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function getGunRayHit(params)
    local _, murderer, targetPart = getGunTarget(false)
    if not murderer or not targetPart then return nil end
    return raycastToTarget(targetPart)
end
local function getKnifeRayHit()
    local _, targetPlayer, targetPart = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPart then return nil end
    return raycastToTarget(targetPart)
end
local function getGunTargetCFrame()
    local targetCFrame = getGunTarget( false )
    if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
    local result = getGunRayHit()
    if result and result.Position then return CFrame.new( result.Position ) end
    return nil
end
local function getEquippedGunTool()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun" then return child end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Shot redirection
local function isGunShotRemote(instance)
    if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not (instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then return false end
    local lowerName = string.lower(instance.Name)
    local lowerPath = string.lower(instance:GetFullName())
    if not (string.find(lowerName, "shoot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "shot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "fire", 1, true)
        or string.find(lowerName, "hit", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "shootgun", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "knifeserver", 1, true)) then

    while ancestor and ancestor ~= game do
        if ancestor:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(ancestor.Name)
            local isGun = ancestor:FindFirstChild("IsGun") ~= nil or CollectionService:HasTag(ancestor, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun"

    local targetPosition, targetPart = getGunRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if State.GunRageMode then
            local spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
            if spoofedOrigin and targetCFrame then
                args[1] = spoofedOrigin
                args[2] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        else
            args[2] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        end
    end
    local function replaceArgument(index)
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[index] = targetPosition
            return true
        elseif valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[index] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Ray" then
            local originalRay = args[index]
            local direction = targetPosition - originalRay.Origin
            if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                args[index] = Ray.new(originalRay.Origin, direction.Unit * math.max(originalRay.Direction.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude) )
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Instance" and args[index] ~= LocalPlayer.Character and targetPart then
            args[index] = targetPart
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and replaceArgument(2) then return true end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        if index ~= 2 and replaceArgument(index) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)

    local throwDirection = targetPosition - throwOrigin
    if throwDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        throwDirection = throwDirection.Unit

    if argumentCount == 1 then

            args[1] = args[1].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition

        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then

    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then

    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin.Position
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do

        if valueType == "CFrame" then

            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin.Position

local function installNamecallHook()
    if OriginalWorkspaceNamecall or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end
    local namecallHook
    namecallHook = function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args = { ... }
        local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isKnifeThrowRemote(self) then

                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)

        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.GunAimV2 or State.GunRageMode or premiumGunAimIsEnabled())
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isGunShotRemote(self) then

                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if self == workspace and method == "Raycast" and not BypassWeaponAimRedirect and not State.RoundCombatSuspended and isPlaying() then
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") and not State.GunRageMode and (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]) then

local function installWeaponHook()
    if type(WeaponService) ~= "table" or WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked then return end
    WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = true
    local function redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if State.RoundCombatSuspended then return nil end
        if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return nil end
        if (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and not State.GunRageMode and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") then
            local targetCFrame = getGunTargetCFrame()
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end

        if (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2)) and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then
            local targetCFrame = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local mouseWrapper
    local targetWrapper
    mouseWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceMouseRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    targetWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceTargetRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
        mouseWrapper = newcclosure(mouseWrapper)
        targetWrapper = newcclosure(targetWrapper)
    end
    local hooked = false
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame) == "function"
        and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition) == "function" then
        local okMouse, rawMouse = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame, mouseWrapper )
        local okTarget, rawTarget = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition, targetWrapper )
        if okMouse and okTarget and type(rawMouse) == "function" and type(rawTarget) == "function" then
            WeaponServiceMouseRaw = rawMouse
            WeaponServiceTargetRaw = rawTarget
            hooked = true
        end
    end
    if not hooked then
        WeaponServiceMouseRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        WeaponServiceTargetRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = mouseWrapper
        WeaponService.GetTargetPosition = targetWrapper
    end
end

local Janitor = {}
Janitor.__index = Janitor

function Janitor.new()
	return setmetatable({ _tasks = {} :: { any } }, Janitor)
end

function Janitor:Add<T>(taskObj: T): T
	table.insert(self._tasks, taskObj)
	return taskObj
end

function Janitor:Cleanup()
	for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do
		local taskObj = self._tasks[i]
		self._tasks[i] = nil
		if typeof(taskObj) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			taskObj:Disconnect()
		elseif typeof(taskObj) == "Instance" then
			taskObj:Destroy()
		elseif type(taskObj) == "function" then
			taskObj()
		elseif type(taskObj) == "table" and type(taskObj.Destroy) == "function" then
			taskObj:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

type FrameSlot = {
	timestamp: number,
	cframes: { [number]: CFrame },
}

local ReplayBuffer = {}
ReplayBuffer.__index = ReplayBuffer

function ReplayBuffer.new(capacity: number)
	local slots = table.create(capacity) :: { FrameSlot }
	for i = 1, capacity do
		slots[i] = {
			timestamp = 0,
			cframes = {},
		}
	end
	return setmetatable({
		_capacity = capacity,
		_slots = slots,
		_head = 0,
		_count = 0,
	}, ReplayBuffer)
end

function ReplayBuffer:Clear()
	self._head = 0
	self._count = 0
	for i = 1, self._capacity do
		self._slots[i].timestamp = 0
		table.clear(self._slots[i].cframes)
	end
end

function ReplayBuffer:Push(timestamp: number, trackedParts: { BasePart })
	self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
	if self._count < self._capacity then
		self._count += 1
	end

	local slot = self._slots[self._head]
	slot.timestamp = timestamp
	local cfMap = slot.cframes
	table.clear(cfMap)

	for partId, part in ipairs(trackedParts) do
		if part.Parent ~= nil then
			cfMap[partId] = part.CFrame
		end
	end
end

function ReplayBuffer:GetWindowFrames(windowSec: number): { FrameSlot }
	if self._count == 0 then
		return {}
	end

	local newestSlot = self._slots[self._head]
	local cutoffTime = newestSlot.timestamp - windowSec
	local result = {}

	local startOffset = self._count - 1
	for offset = startOffset, 0, -1 do
		local idx = ((self._head - 1 - offset) % self._capacity) + 1
		local slot = self._slots[idx]
		if slot.timestamp >= cutoffTime then
			table.insert(result, slot)
		end
	end

	return result
end

function ReplayBuffer:GetCount(): number
	return self._count
end

		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "_HilosHAX_GhostVisuals"
		folder.Parent = workspace
		self._rootFolder = folder
	end
	if not self._pathFolder or not self._pathFolder.Parent then
		local pFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		pFolder.Name = "PathTrail"
		pFolder.Parent = self._rootFolder
		self._pathFolder = pFolder
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:BuildGhostFromParts(trackedParts: { BasePart }, rootPartId: number)
	self:ClearGhost()
	self:_EnsureFolders()
	self._rootPartId = rootPartId

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "HilosHAX_GhostRig"

	for partId, srcPart in ipairs(trackedParts) do
		local ghostPart: BasePart? = nil

		local ok, cloned = pcall(function()
			local prevArchivable = srcPart.Archivable
			srcPart.Archivable = true
			local c = srcPart:Clone()
			srcPart.Archivable = prevArchivable
			return c
		end)

		if ok and cloned and cloned:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, child in ipairs(cloned:GetChildren()) do
				if not (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("DataModelMesh")) then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			ghostPart = cloned
		else
			local fallback = Instance.new("Part")
			fallback.Size = srcPart.Size
			fallback.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
			ghostPart = fallback
		end

		if ghostPart then
			local isInvisibleRoot = (srcPart.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and srcPart.Transparency >= 0.99)
			ghostPart.Name = "Ghost_" .. tostring(partId)
			ghostPart.Anchored = true
			ghostPart.CanCollide = false
			ghostPart.CanTouch = false
			ghostPart.CanQuery = false
			ghostPart.CastShadow = false
			ghostPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			ghostPart.Color = CONFIG.GHOST_COLOR
			ghostPart.Transparency = if isInvisibleRoot then 1 else CONFIG.GHOST_TRANSPARENCY
			ghostPart.CFrame = srcPart.CFrame
			ghostPart.Parent = model

			self._ghostParts[partId] = ghostPart
		end
	end

	model.Parent = self._rootFolder
	self._ghostModel = model
end

function GhostVisualizer:RenderPathTrail(frames: { FrameSlot }, rootPartId: number)
	self:ClearPath()
	if not self._showPath or #frames < 2 then
		return
	end
	self:_EnsureFolders()

	local prevPos: Vector3? = nil
	local step = math.max(1, CONFIG.PATH_NODE_INTERVAL)

	for i = 1, #frames, step do
		local cf = frames[i].cframes[rootPartId]
		if cf then
			local pos = cf.Position
			if prevPos then
				local dist = (pos - prevPos).Magnitude
				if dist > 0.05 then
					local seg = Instance.new("Part")
					seg.Name = "PathSeg"
					seg.Anchored = true
					seg.CanCollide = false
					seg.CanTouch = false
					seg.CanQuery = false
					seg.CastShadow = false
					seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					seg.Color = CONFIG.GHOST_ACCENT
					seg.Transparency = 0.45
					seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, dist)
					seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(prevPos:Lerp(pos, 0.5), pos)
					seg.Parent = self._pathFolder
				end
			end
			prevPos = pos
		end
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:StartPlayback(frames: { FrameSlot }, trackedParts: { BasePart }, rootPartId: number)
	if #frames < 2 then
		return false
	end

	self:BuildGhostFromParts(trackedParts, rootPartId)
	self._frames = frames
	self._elapsed = 0
	self._duration = math.max(0.001, frames[#frames].timestamp - frames[1].timestamp)
	self._isPlaying = true

	self:RenderPathTrail(frames, rootPartId)
	self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(0)
	return true
end

function GhostVisualizer:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha: number)
	local frames = self._frames
	local count = #frames
	if count < 2 then
		return
	end

	alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
	local startTime = frames[1].timestamp
	local targetTime = startTime + (self._duration * alpha)

	local lo = 1
	local hi = count
	while hi - lo > 1 do
		local mid = math.floor((lo + hi) / 2)
		if frames[mid].timestamp <= targetTime then
			lo = mid
		else
			hi = mid
		end
	end

	local frameA = frames[lo]
	local frameB = frames[hi]
	local span = frameB.timestamp - frameA.timestamp
	local t = if span > 0.0001 then math.clamp((targetTime - frameA.timestamp) / span, 0, 1) else 0

	for partId, ghostPart in pairs(self._ghostParts) do
		local cfA = frameA.cframes[partId]
		local cfB = frameB.cframes[partId]
		if cfA and cfB then
			ghostPart.CFrame = cfA:Lerp(cfB, t)
		elseif cfA then
			ghostPart.CFrame = cfA
		elseif cfB then
			ghostPart.CFrame = cfB
		end
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:Step(dt: number)
	if not self._isPlaying or #self._frames < 2 then
		return
	end

	self._elapsed += dt * self._playbackSpeed
	local alpha = self._elapsed / self._duration

	if alpha >= 1 then
		if self._isLooping then
			self._elapsed = self._elapsed % self._duration
			alpha = self._elapsed / self._duration
		else
			alpha = 1
			self._isPlaying = false
			self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha)
			if self._onProgress then
				self._onProgress(1)
			end
			if self._onFinished then
				self._onFinished()
			end
			return
		end
	end

	self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha)
	if self._onProgress then
		self._onProgress(alpha)
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:Scrub(alpha: number)
	if #self._frames < 2 then
		return
	end
	self._elapsed = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1) * self._duration
	self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha)
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetPlaying(playing: boolean)
	self._isPlaying = playing
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetLooping(looping: boolean)
	self._isLooping = looping
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetShowPath(show: boolean)
	self._showPath = show
	if not show then
		self:ClearPath()
	elseif #self._frames >= 2 then
		self:RenderPathTrail(self._frames, self._rootPartId)
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetSpeed(speed: number)
	self._playbackSpeed = math.clamp(speed, 0.1, 4.0)
end

function GhostVisualizer:ClearGhost()
	self._isPlaying = false
	table.clear(self._ghostParts)
	if self._ghostModel then
		self._ghostModel:Destroy()
		self._ghostModel = nil
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:ClearPath()
	if self._pathFolder then
		self._pathFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:Destroy()
	self:ClearGhost()
	self:ClearPath()
	if self._rootFolder then
		self._rootFolder:Destroy()
		self._rootFolder = nil
	end
end

local function tween(obj: Instance, props: { [string]: any }, duration: number?)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, info, props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function bindCharacter(character: Model)
	CharJanitor:Cleanup()
	table.clear(state.trackedParts)
	buffer:Clear()

	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not character.Parent then
		return
	end

	table.clear(state.trackedParts)
	state.rootPartId = 1

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(state.trackedParts, desc)
			if desc == hrp or desc.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
				state.rootPartId = #state.trackedParts
			end
		end
	end

	CharJanitor:Add(character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(state.trackedParts, desc)
		end
	end))

	CharJanitor:Add(character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(desc)
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			local idx = table.find(state.trackedParts, desc)
			if idx then
				table.remove(state.trackedParts, idx)
			end
		end
	end))
end

	valLbl.Text = string.format("%.2f%s", defaultVal, suffix)

	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 6)
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 29)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 48, 72)
	track.Text = ""
	track.AutoButtonColor = false
	track.Parent = container
	addCorner(track, 3)

	local initAlpha = math.clamp((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(initAlpha, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = CONFIG.UI_ACCENT_LIGHT
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	addCorner(fill, 3)

	local dragging = false
	local function updateFromInput(inputPos: Vector3)
		local relX = math.clamp((inputPos.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
		local val = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * relX
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0)
		valLbl.Text = string.format("%.2f%s", val, suffix)
		onChanged(val)
	end

	track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			updateFromInput(input.Position)
		end
	end)

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			updateFromInput(input.Position)
		end
	end))

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))

	return {
		SetVisual = function(alpha: number)
			if not dragging then
				alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
				fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
				local val = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * alpha
				valLbl.Text = string.format("%.2f%s", val, suffix)
			end
		end,
	}
end

	local startPos: UDim2

	header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

			startPos = mainFrame.Position
		end
	end)

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end))

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
end

AppJanitor:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	if state.isRecording and #state.trackedParts > 0 then
		state.sampleAccumulator += dt
		if state.sampleAccumulator >= SAMPLE_INTERVAL then
			state.sampleAccumulator %= SAMPLE_INTERVAL
			buffer:Push(os.clock(), state.trackedParts)
		end
	end

	telemetryLabel.Text = string.format(
		"REC: %s | FRAMES: %d/%d | PARTS: %d",
		if state.isRecording then "ACTIVE" else "PAUSED",
		buffer:GetCount(),
		MAX_FRAMES,
		#state.trackedParts
	)
end))

AppJanitor:Add(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
	visualizer:Step(dt)
end))

local function stopAudio()
    if currentSound then
        currentSound:Stop()
        currentSound:Destroy()
        currentSound = nil
    end
    currentPlayingCode = nil
    
    for code, btnInfo in pairs(activePlayButtons) do
        if btnInfo and btnInfo.Button and btnInfo.Button.Parent then
            btnInfo.Button.Text = "▶"
            btnInfo.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226)
        end
    end
end

local function playAudio(id, btn)
    local cleanId = id:match("%d+")
    if not cleanId then return end

    if currentPlayingCode == cleanId then
        stopAudio()
        return
    end

    stopAudio()

    currentPlayingCode = cleanId
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
    sound.Volume = 1
    sound.Looped = true
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    sound:Play()
    currentSound = sound

    if btn then
        btn.Text = "⏹"
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 140, 0)
    end

    sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        if currentPlayingCode == cleanId then
            stopAudio()
        end
    end)
end

scripts.title: Spider man script by brock123 (Made with ia)
scripts.author: Brock123
scripts.summary: Spider man script
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- AJUSTES
local MAX_SPEED = 160
local BOOST = 90
local STEER = 40
local REEL = 12
local MIN_LEN = 22
local WEB_RANGE = 230
local SKY_FALLBACK = true
local FORWARD = 40
local HEIGHT = 55
local SIDE = 14
local AUTO_CHAIN = true
local DIVE_FALL_SPEED = 30
local DIVE_PULLUP = 24
local CAMERA_ROLL = 0

-- CONFIGURAÇÕES (mudam pelo botão Config)
local skyWeb = SKY_FALLBACK
local autoChain = AUTO_CHAIN
local autoDive = true
local toast = function() end

local V = Vector3.new

local anchor, att, handAtt
local swinging, holding = false, false
local swingStart, swingEnd = 0, 0
local swingDir = V(0, 0, -1)
local sideSign = 1
local shootArm = "r"
local len, minLen = 0, MIN_LEN
local lastDash = 0
local firstPerson = false
local roll = 0
local recovering = false
local diving = false
local diveDir = V(0, 0, -1)
local diveCooldown = 0

local function getChar() return player.Character end
local function getRoot()
	local c = getChar()
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getHum()
	local c = getChar()
	return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function rayParams()
	local list = {getChar()}
	local ef = workspace:FindFirstChild("InimigosLocais")
	if ef then table.insert(list, ef) end
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
	return p
end
local function flat(v)
	local f = V(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if f.Magnitude < 0.01 then return nil end
	return f.Unit
end
local function setOrientation(root, targetRot, a)
	local cf = root.CFrame
	local rot = cf - cf.Position
	local newRot = rot:Lerp(targetRot, math.min(1, a))
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.Position) * newRot
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = V(0, 0, 0)
end

-- ANIMAÇÕES (por código)
local joints, orig, current = {}, {}, {}
local poseName = nil

local function mirror(p)
	local m = {}
	for k, v in pairs(p) do
		local first = string.sub(k, 1, 1)
		local rest = string.sub(k, 2)
		local nk = k
		if first == "r" then nk = "l" .. rest end
		if first == "l" then nk = "r" .. rest end
		m[nk] = V(v.X, -v.Y, -v.Z)
	end
	return m
end

local swingBase = {
	rs = V(20, 0, 165), ls = V(-35, 0, -30),
	re = V(15, 0, 0), le = V(10, 0, 0),
	rh = V(-30, 0, 5), lh = V(12, 0, -5),
	rk = V(-55, 0, 0), lk = V(-18, 0, 0),
}
local swingFBase = {
	rs = V(110, 0, 12), ls = V(-20, 0, -20),
	re = V(10, 0, 0), le = V(10, 0, 0),
	rh = V(-30, 0, 5), lh = V(12, 0, -5),
	rk = V(-55, 0, 0), lk = V(-18, 0, 0),
}
local punchBase = {
	rs = V(95, 0, 5), ls = V(40, 0, -25),
	rh = V(-15, 0, 0), lh = V(15, 0, 0),
}

local POSES = {
	swingR = swingBase,
	swingL = mirror(swingBase),
	swingFR = swingFBase,
	swingFL = mirror(swingFBase),
	dive = {
		rs = V(-5, 0, 80), ls = V(-5, 0, -80),
		re = V(10, 0, 0), le = V(10, 0, 0),
		rh = V(-8, 0, 4), lh = V(-8, 0, -4),
		rk = V(-10, 0, 0), lk = V(-10, 0, 0),
	},
	diveF = {
		rs = V(30, 0, 40), ls = V(30, 0, -40),
		rh = V(-8, 0, 4), lh = V(-8, 0, -4),
		rk = V(-10, 0, 0), lk = V(-10, 0, 0),
	},
	jump = {
		rs = V(0, 0, 150), ls = V(0, 0, -150),
		rh = V(25, 0, 0), lh = V(-5, 0, 0),
		rk = V(-60, 0, 0), lk = V(-20, 0, 0),
	},
	c_punchR = punchBase,
	c_punchL = mirror(punchBase),
	c_kick = {
		rs = V(30, 0, 35), ls = V(30, 0, -35),
		rh = V(85, 0, 0), lh = V(-10, 0, 0),
		lk = V(-10, 0, 0),
	},
	c_web = { rs = V(100, 0, 10), ls = V(20, 0, -20) },
	c_dodge = {
		rs = V(20, 0, 60), ls = V(20, 0, -60),
		rh = V(-25, 0, 10), lh = V(-25, 0, -10),
		rk = V(-40, 0, 0), lk = V(-40, 0, 0),
	},
}

local function isSwing(n)
	return n ~= nil and string.sub(n, 1, 5) == "swing"
end
local function isCombat(n)
	return n ~= nil and string.sub(n, 1, 2) == "c_"
end

local function refreshJoints()
	joints, orig, current = {}, {}, {}
	local c = getChar()
	if not c then return end
	local hum = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if not hum then return end
	local function m(part, name)
		local p = c:WaitForChild(part, 3)
		return p and p:FindFirstChild(name)
	end
	if hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		joints.rs = m("RightUpperArm", "RightShoulder")
		joints.ls = m("LeftUpperArm", "LeftShoulder")
		joints.re = m("RightLowerArm", "RightElbow")
		joints.le = m("LeftLowerArm", "LeftElbow")
		joints.rh = m("RightUpperLeg", "RightHip")
		joints.lh = m("LeftUpperLeg", "LeftHip")
		joints.rk = m("RightLowerLeg", "RightKnee")
		joints.lk = m("LeftLowerLeg", "LeftKnee")
	else
		joints.rs = m("Torso", "Right Shoulder")
		joints.ls = m("Torso", "Left Shoulder")
		joints.rh = m("Torso", "Right Hip")
		joints.lh = m("Torso", "Left Hip")
	end
	for k, j in pairs(joints) do
		orig[k] = j.C0
		current[k] = V(0, 0, 0)
	end
end

local function stopTracks()
	local hum = getHum()
	local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if animator then
		for _, t in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			t:Stop(0.1)
		end
	end
end

local function setPose(name)
	if name == poseName then return end
	local wasNil = (poseName == nil)
	poseName = name
	local c = getChar()
	local animate = c and c:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if animate then
		if name ~= nil then
			if wasNil then stopTracks() end
			animate.Disabled = true
		else
			animate.Disabled = false
		end
	end
end

local function swingPoseName()
	local n = "swing"
	if firstPerson then n = "swingF" end
	if shootArm == "l" then
		n = n .. "L"
	else
		n = n .. "R"
	end
	return n
end

local function divePoseName()
	if firstPerson then return "diveF" end
	return "dive"
end

-- poses de combate (vêm do script de Combate)
local function onCombatPose()
	local c = getChar()
	if not c then return end
	local n = c:GetAttribute("CombatPose")
	if n and n ~= "" then
		if (poseName == nil or isCombat(poseName)) and POSES[n] then
			setPose(n)
		end
	else
		if isCombat(poseName) then setPose(nil) end
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local pd = nil
	if poseName then
		pd = POSES[poseName]
	end
	local alpha = math.min(1, dt * 9)
	if isCombat(poseName) then
		alpha = math.min(1, dt * 20)
	end
	local sw = math.sin(tick() * 2.5) * 6
	local inSwing = isSwing(poseName)
	for k, j in pairs(joints) do
		if j.Parent and orig[k] then
			local tgt = V(0, 0, 0)
			if pd and pd[k] then
				tgt = pd[k]
			end
			if inSwing then
				if k == "rh" then
					tgt = tgt + V(sw, 0, 0)
				end
				if k == "lh" then
					tgt = tgt - V(sw, 0, 0)
				end
			end
			local cur = current[k]:Lerp(tgt, alpha)
			current[k] = cur
			j.C0 = orig[k] * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cur.X), math.rad(cur.Y), math.rad(cur.Z))
		end
	end
end)

-- VOLTAR AO NORMAL (levanta o corpo suave)
local function recoverControl()
	local root, hum = getRoot(), getHum()
	if not root or not hum then return end
	if recovering then return end
	recovering = true
	task.spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 6 do
			if swinging or diving then
				recovering = false
				return
			end
			local cf = root.CFrame
			local look = V(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
			if look.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				look = V(cf.UpVector.X, 0, cf.UpVector.Z)
			end
			if look.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				look = V(0, 0, -1)
			end
			local target = CFrame.lookAt(V(0, 0, 0), look.Unit)
			setOrientation(root, target, 0.45)
			task.wait()
		end
		recovering = false
		if not swinging and not diving then
			hum.AutoRotate = true
			hum.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end)
end

-- MERGULHO
local function stopDive(landing, keep)
	if not diving then return end
	diving = false
	diveCooldown = tick() + 1.2
	local root = getRoot()
	if landing and root then
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = V(v.X * 0.8, v.Y * 0.4, v.Z * 0.8)
	end
	if poseName == "dive" or poseName == "diveF" then setPose(nil) end
	if not keep then recoverControl() end
end

local function startDive(root, hum)
	diving = true
	local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	diveDir = V(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
	if diveDir.Magnitude < 1 then
		local l = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
		diveDir = V(l.X, 0, l.Z)
	end
	if diveDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		diveDir = diveDir.Unit
	else
		diveDir = V(0, 0, -1)
	end
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	setPose(divePoseName())
end

-- TEIA
local function pickAnchor(root)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	local look = flat(cam.LookVector) or flat(root.CFrame.LookVector) or V(0, 0, -1)
	local right = flat(cam.RightVector) or V(1, 0, 0)
	local params = rayParams()

	sideSign = -sideSign
	local side = sideSign

	local pitches = {50, 38, 62, 28, 72}
	local leans = {0.25, 0.1, 0.4, -0.2}
	local found = nil
	for _, deg in ipairs(pitches) do
		for _, ln in ipairs(leans) do
			local pr = math.rad(deg)
			local horiz = (look + right * (ln * side)).Unit
			local dir = (horiz * math.cos(pr) + V(0, math.sin(pr), 0)).Unit
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, dir * WEB_RANGE, params)
			if hit and hit.Distance > 16 and hit.Position.Y > root.Position.Y + 14 then
				found = hit.Position
				break
			end
		end
		if found then break end
	end

	if found then
		return found, look
	end
	if skyWeb then
		local target = root.Position + look * FORWARD + right * (SIDE * side) + V(0, HEIGHT, 0)
		return target, look
	end
	return nil, look
end

local function cleanup(keep)
	if swinging then swingEnd = tick() end
	swinging = false
	if att then att:Destroy() att = nil end
	if handAtt then handAtt:Destroy() handAtt = nil end
	if anchor then anchor:Destroy() anchor = nil end
	if not keep and not diving then
		recoverControl()
	end
end

local function stopWeb(release)
	local root = getRoot()
	if release and swinging and root then
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		if v.Magnitude > 1 then
			root:ApplyImpulse(V(0, root.AssemblyMass * 35, 0) + v.Unit * root.AssemblyMass * 25)
		end
	end
	cleanup()
end

local function getHand()
	local c = getChar()
	if not c then return nil end
	if shootArm == "r" then
		return c:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or c:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	end
	return c:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or c:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
end

local function startWeb(chain)
	local root, hum = getRoot(), getHum()
	if not root or not hum then return end

	local pos, look = pickAnchor(root)
	if not pos then
		if chain then
			cleanup()
		else
			toast("Sem prédio por perto")
		end
		return
	end

	stopDive(false, true)
	cleanup(true)
	swingDir = look
	if sideSign == 1 then
		shootArm = "r"
	else
		shootArm = "l"
	end

	anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.CanQuery = false
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	anchor.Position = pos
	anchor.Parent = workspace

	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", anchor)
	att = Instance.new("Attachment", root)

	local dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
	len = dist
	minLen = math.max(MIN_LEN, dist * 0.45)

	local from = att
	local hand = getHand()
	if hand then
		handAtt = Instance.new("Attachment", hand)
		from = handAtt
	end
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = from
	beam.Attachment1 = a0
	beam.Width0 = 0.14
	beam.Width1 = 0.14
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightEmission = 0.6
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	beam.Parent = anchor

	swinging = true
	swingStart = tick()
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	local power = 45
	if chain then power = 18 end
	root:ApplyImpulse((pos - root.Position).Unit * root.AssemblyMass * power)
	setPose(swingPoseName())
end

local function updateSwing(root, hum, dt)
	if not anchor then
		cleanup()
		return
	end
	local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local pos = root.Position
	local aPos = anchor.Position
	local d = pos - aPos
	local dist = d.Magnitude
	if dist < 0.5 then
		cleanup()
		return
	end
	local n = d / dist

	-- corda sem folga, encurtando aos poucos
	if dist < len then len = dist end
	len = len - REEL * dt
	if len < minLen then len = minLen end

	-- impulso: mais forte quando está embaixo do ponto de apoio
	local below = math.clamp((aPos.Y - pos.Y) / dist, 0, 1)
	local v = vel
	if vel.Magnitude > 1 and vel.Magnitude < MAX_SPEED then
		v = v + vel.Unit * (BOOST * (0.3 + 0.7 * below)) * dt
	end
	v = v + hum.MoveDirection * STEER * dt

	-- chão: mola suave
	local ground = workspace:Raycast(pos, V(0, -10, 0), rayParams())
	if ground then
		local k = 1 - ground.Distance / 10
		v = v + V(0, (240 * k - 3 * v.Y * k) * dt, 0)
	end

	-- corda esticada: tira a velocidade pra fora e puxa de volta
	if dist >= len - 0.3 then
		local desired = -math.min(math.max(dist - len, 0) * 10, 40)
		local cur = v:Dot(n)
		if cur > desired then
			v = v + n * (desired - cur)
		end
	end

	-- corpo na direção do movimento, inclinado pro lado da teia
	local flatV = V(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	if flatV.Magnitude > 3 then
		swingDir = swingDir:Lerp(flatV.Unit, math.min(1, dt * 4))
	end
	local tilt = -45
	if firstPerson then tilt = -12 end
	local bank = 10
	if shootArm == "r" then bank = -10 end
	if swingDir.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local target = CFrame.lookAt(V(0, 0, 0), swingDir.Unit) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tilt), 0, math.rad(bank))
		setOrientation(root, target, dt * 10)
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v

	-- troca de teia sozinho
	if holding and autoChain and tick() - swingStart > 0.7 and flatV.Magnitude > 15 then
		local toA = aPos - pos
		local flatA = V(toA.X, 0, toA.Z)
		if flatA.Magnitude > 1 and flatV.Unit:Dot(flatA.Unit) < -0.15 then
			root:ApplyImpulse(V(0, root.AssemblyMass * 25, 0))
			startWeb(true)
		end
	end
end

local function updateAir(root, hum, dt)
	local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local grounded = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

	if diving then
		local near = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, V(0, -DIVE_PULLUP, 0), rayParams())
		if grounded or near or vel.Y > -5 then
			stopDive(near ~= nil and not grounded, false)
			return
		end
		local flatV = V(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
		if flatV.Magnitude > 3 then
			diveDir = diveDir:Lerp(flatV.Unit, math.min(1, dt * 2))
		end
		local v = vel + hum.MoveDirection * 60 * dt
		if diveDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			v = v + diveDir.Unit * 30 * dt
		end
		if vel.Magnitude < MAX_SPEED then
			v = v + V(0, -40 * dt, 0)
		end
		local pitch = -80
		if firstPerson then pitch = -35 end
		if diveDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			local target = CFrame.lookAt(V(0, 0, 0), diveDir.Unit) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch), 0, 0)
			setOrientation(root, target, dt * 6)
		end
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v
	else
		if autoDive and not recovering and tick() > diveCooldown and not grounded and vel.Y < -DIVE_FALL_SPEED then
			local near = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, V(0, -(DIVE_PULLUP + 8), 0), rayParams())

		end
		if isSwing(poseName) and (grounded or tick() - swingEnd > 0.7) then
			setPose(nil)
		end
	end
end

local focusPos = V(0, 0, 0)

pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SpiderFocus") end)
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SpiderCamera") end)

RunService:BindToRenderStep("SpiderFocus", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function(dt)
	local root, hum = getRoot(), getHum()
	if not root or not hum then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local want = (swinging or diving) and not firstPerson
	local target = root.Position + V(0, 1.5, 0)
	if want then
		if not focusActive then
			focusActive = true
			focusPos = target
			cam.CameraSubject = focus
		end
		focusPos = focusPos:Lerp(target, math.min(1, dt * 25))
		focus.CFrame = CFrame.new(focusPos)
	elseif focusActive then
		focusActive = false
		cam.CameraSubject = hum
	end
end)

local smoothSpeed = 0
RunService:BindToRenderStep("SpiderCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local root, hum = getRoot(), getHum()
	if not root or not hum then return end
	local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

	smoothSpeed = smoothSpeed + (vel.Magnitude - smoothSpeed) * math.min(1, dt * 3)
	local targetFov = 70 + math.clamp(smoothSpeed - 20, 0, 150) * 0.15
	cam.FieldOfView = cam.FieldOfView + (targetFov - cam.FieldOfView) * math.min(1, dt * 3)

	if firstPerson then
		local c = getChar()
		if c then
			for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					if d.Name == "Head" or d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
						d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
					else
						d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local bob = 0
		if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			bob = math.sin(tick() * 10) * 0.08
		end
		hum.CameraOffset = hum.CameraOffset:Lerp(V(0, 0.15 + bob, -0.7), 0.3)
	elseif hum.CameraOffset ~= V(0, 0, 0) then
		hum.CameraOffset = V(0, 0, 0)
	end

	if CAMERA_ROLL > 0 then
		local targetRoll = 0
		if swinging then
			local rel = cam.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(vel)
			targetRoll = math.clamp(-rel.X / 80, -1, 1) * math.rad(CAMERA_ROLL)
		end
		roll = roll + (targetRoll - roll) * math.min(1, dt * 2)
		cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll)
	end
end)

function SUFFIX:CreateTab(iconInput)
    local icon = iconInput or "rbxassetid://14456045412"

    local TabBtn = Instance.new("ImageButton")
    TabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 34)
    TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
    TabBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    
    if icon:find("rbxassetid://") or icon:find("rbxthumb://") then
        TabBtn.Image = icon
    else
        TabBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://14456045412"
    end
    
    TabBtn.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    TabBtn.Parent = self.TabList

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    Corner.Parent = TabBtn

    -- Page Scrolling Frame
    local Page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    Page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    Page.Visible = false
    Page.Parent = self.ContentArea

    local PageLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    PageLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    PageLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    PageLayout.Parent = Page

    local PagePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    PagePadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
    PagePadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
    PagePadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
    PagePadding.Parent = Page

    table.insert(self.TabButtons, TabBtn)
    table.insert(self.Pages, Page)

    if #self.Pages == 1 then
        Page.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        TabBtn.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end

    TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, p in ipairs(self.Pages) do p.Visible = false end
        for _, t in ipairs(self.TabButtons) do
            t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
            t.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
        end
        Page.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        TabBtn.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)

    local TabObj = {}

    function TabObj:CreateSection(sectionText)
        local SecLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        SecLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        SecLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        SecLabel.Text = "  " .. sectionText
        SecLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
        SecLabel.TextSize = 12
        SecLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        SecLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        SecLabel.Parent = Page
        return SecLabel
    end

    function TabObj:CreateButton(name, callback)
        local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
        Btn.Text = "  " .. name
        Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
        Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        Btn.TextSize = 13
        Btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Btn.Parent = Page

        local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        BtnCorner.Parent = Btn

        Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if callback then pcall(callback) end
        end)
        return Btn
    end

    function TabObj:CreateToggle(name, defaultState, callback)
        local toggled = defaultState or false

        local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
        ToggleBtn.Text = "  " .. name
        ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
        ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        ToggleBtn.TextSize = 13
        ToggleBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        ToggleBtn.Parent = Page

        local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn

        local StatusIndicator = Instance.new("Frame")
        StatusIndicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
        StatusIndicator.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        StatusIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
        StatusIndicator.BackgroundColor3 = toggled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        StatusIndicator.Parent = ToggleBtn

        local IndicatorCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        IndicatorCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        IndicatorCorner.Parent = StatusIndicator

        ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            toggled = not toggled
            StatusIndicator.BackgroundColor3 = toggled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
            if callback then pcall(function() callback(toggled) end) end
        end)

        return ToggleBtn
    end

    function TabObj:CreateLabel(text)
        local Lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
        Lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Lbl.Text = "  " .. text
        Lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
        Lbl.TextSize = 12
        Lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        Lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Lbl.Parent = Page
        return Lbl
    end

    return TabObj
end

function SUFFIX:Close(windowInstance)
    if windowInstance and windowInstance.ScreenGui then
        windowInstance.ScreenGui:Destroy()
    end
end

local function Stroke(parent, color, thickness)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")

	s.Parent = parent

local function Corner(parent, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)

	return c
end

local function Anim(obj, props, time)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(time or 0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	t:Play()
	return t

local function CreateSlider(titleText, suffix, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, callback)
	local Row = Instance.new("Frame")

	local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")

	Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Track

	Bar.Parent = Hitbox
	Corner(Bar, 99)

	local initRatio = (defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
	local TargetRatio = initRatio
	local CurrentRatio = initRatio

	local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	Fill.Size = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 1, 0)
	Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.Accent
	Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local Thumb = Instance.new("Frame")

	Thumb.Position = UDim2.new(initRatio, 0, 0.5, 0)
	Thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Palette.TextPrimary
	Thumb.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Thumb.ZIndex = 2
	Thumb.Parent = Bar
	Corner(Thumb, 99)
	Stroke(Thumb, Palette.Base, 1.5)

	local Sliding = false
	local function Update(input)
		local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		TargetRatio = pos
		local val = math.floor(minVal + ((maxVal - minVal) * pos) + 0.5)
		ValueText.Text = tostring(val) .. suffix
		callback(val)

local function GetVehicleSeat()
	local Char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local Hum = Char and Char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if Hum and Hum.SeatPart and Hum.SeatPart:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		return Hum.SeatPart
	end
	local CarsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CrashTest") and Workspace.CrashTest:FindFirstChild("Cars")
	if CarsFolder then
		for _, car in ipairs(CarsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if string.find(car.Name, LocalPlayer.Name) and car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") then
				return car.DriverSeat
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not Config.Enabled then return end

	local Seat = GetVehicleSeat()
	if not Seat then return end

	local Throttle = Seat.ThrottleFloat
	local Steer = Seat.SteerFloat
	local CurrentVel = Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local Speed = CurrentVel.Magnitude

	if Config.SpeedBoost > 0 and math.abs(Throttle) > 0.05 then
		if Speed < Config.MaxSpeedLimit then
			local Forward = Seat.CFrame.LookVector * Throttle
			local Boost = Forward * (Config.SpeedBoost * dt * 2.2)
			local Down = Vector3.new(0, -Config.Downforce * dt * 0.5, 0)
			Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = CurrentVel + Boost + Down
		end
	end

	if Config.TurnAssist > 0 and math.abs(Steer) > 0.05 and Speed > 10 then
		local SpeedScale = math.clamp(Speed / 80, 0.7, 2.5)
		local TargetYaw = -Steer * (Config.TurnAssist * 0.04) * SpeedScale
		local AngVel = Seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		Seat.AssemblyAngularVelocity = AngVel:Lerp(Vector3.new(AngVel.X, TargetYaw, AngVel.Z), 0.35)

		local Dir = Seat.CFrame.LookVector * (Throttle >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		local FlatVel = Vector3.new(CurrentVel.X, 0, CurrentVel.Z)
		local AlignedVel = FlatVel:Lerp(Dir * FlatVel.Magnitude, 0.12)
		Seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(AlignedVel.X, CurrentVel.Y, AlignedVel.Z)
	end
end)

-- Minigame Highlighter (Flow solver + 50% overlay). Run client-side before opening a generator.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local ALPHA = 0.5 -- 50% transparency

------------------------------------------------------------ Flow solver
local function readPoint(v)
	if typeof(v) == "Vector2" then return v.X, v.Y end
	if type(v) == "table" then
		local x = v.x or v.X or v.Col or v.col or v[1]
		local y = v.y or v.Y or v.Row or v.row or v[2]
		return x, y
	end
end

local function normalize(pairsRaw, n)
	local list, minC, maxC = {}, math.huge, -math.huge
	for i, p in ipairs(pairsRaw) do
		local a = p.A or p.a or p.Start or p.From or p[1]
		local b = p.B or p.b or p.End or p.To or p[2]
		local ax, ay = readPoint(a)
		local bx, by = readPoint(b)
		if ax and ay and bx and by then
			for _, c in ipairs({ ax, ay, bx, by }) do
				minC, maxC = math.min(minC, c), math.max(maxC, c)
			end
			local col = p.Color or p.color
			list[#list + 1] = { a = { x = ax, y = ay }, b = { x = bx, y = by },
				color = typeof(col) == "Color3" and col or Color3.fromHSV((i - 1) / #pairsRaw, 0.85, 1) }
		end
	end
	local base = (minC >= 1 and maxC == n) and 1 or 0
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		p.a.x -= base; p.a.y -= base; p.b.x -= base; p.b.y -= base
	end
	return list
end

local function solve(n, pr, requireFull)
	local k, owner, paths, heads, done = #pr, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local filled, nodes = 2 * k, 0
	local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
	for i, p in ipairs(pr) do
		owner[p.a.y * n + p.a.x] = i
		owner[p.b.y * n + p.b.x] = i
		paths[i] = { { x = p.a.x, y = p.a.y } }
		heads[i] = { x = p.a.x, y = p.a.y }
	end
	local function free(x, y) return x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x < n and y < n and owner[y * n + x] == nil end
	local function movesOf(i)
		local h, t, out = heads[i], pr[i].b, {}
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local x, y = h.x + d[1], h.y + d[2]
			if x == t.x and y == t.y then
				out[#out + 1] = { x = x, y = y, fin = true }
			elseif free(x, y) then
				out[#out + 1] = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
		return out
	end
	local function deadCell()
		for y = 0, n - 1 do
			for x = 0, n - 1 do
				if free(x, y) then
					local open = 0
					for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
						local nx, ny = x + d[1], y + d[2]
						if free(nx, ny) then open += 1
						else
							for i = 1, k do
								if not done[i] and ((heads[i].x == nx and heads[i].y == ny) or (pr[i].b.x == nx and pr[i].b.y == ny)) then
									open += 1
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if open < (requireFull and 2 or 0) then return true end
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function search()
		nodes += 1
		if nodes > 3e6 then return false end
		local best, bm
		for i = 1, k do
			if not done[i] then
				local m = movesOf(i)
				if #m == 0 then return false end
				if not bm or #m < #bm then best, bm = i, m end
			end
		end
		if not best then return (not requireFull) or filled == n * n end
		if requireFull and deadCell() then return false end
		for _, m in ipairs(bm) do
			if m.fin then
				done[best] = true
				paths[best][#paths[best] + 1] = { x = m.x, y = m.y }
				if search() then return true end
				table.remove(paths[best]); done[best] = nil
			else
				local old = heads[best]
				owner[m.y * n + m.x] = best; filled += 1
				heads[best] = { x = m.x, y = m.y }
				paths[best][#paths[best] + 1] = heads[best]
				if search() then return true end
				table.remove(paths[best]); heads[best] = old
				owner[m.y * n + m.x] = nil; filled -= 1
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	if search() then return paths end
end

------------------------------------------------------------ Overlay
local function findBoard(container)
	local best, area = nil, 0
	for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local s = d.AbsoluteSize
			if s.X > 50 and math.abs(s.X - s.Y) < 6 and s.X * s.Y > area and s.X * s.Y < container.AbsoluteSize.X * container.AbsoluteSize.Y * 1.01 then
				best, area = d, s.X * s.Y
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function drawFlow(gui, n, pr, paths)
	local board
	for _ = 1, 40 do
		board = findBoard(gui.Container)
		if board then break end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	if not board then return end
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "SolutionOverlay"
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.ZIndex = 100
	overlay.Parent = gui
	for i, path in ipairs(paths) do
		for _, c in ipairs(path) do
			local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
			cell.BorderSizePixel = 0
			cell.BackgroundColor3 = pr[i].color
			cell.BackgroundTransparency = ALPHA
			cell.ZIndex = 100
			cell.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / n, 1 / n)
			cell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(c.x / n, c.y / n)
			cell.Parent = overlay
		end
	end
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not gui.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
		local p = board.AbsolutePosition - gui.AbsolutePosition
		overlay.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
		overlay.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(board.AbsoluteSize.X, board.AbsoluteSize.Y)
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------ Hook
local function activeGui()
	for _, g in ipairs(LP.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
		if g:FindFirstChild("Container") and not g:FindFirstChild("SolutionOverlay") then return g end
	end
end

local function hook(moduleName, onStarted)
	local ok, mod = pcall(function()
		return require(RS.Systems.Player.Game.Minigames[moduleName])
	end)
	if not ok then return warn("highlighter: can't require " .. moduleName) end
	local origSession = mod.Session
	rawset(mod, "Session", function(self, id, props)
		local s = origSession(self, id, props)
		local origStart = s.Start
		s.Start = function(me, ...)
			origStart(me, ...)
			task.spawn(function()
				local gui
				for _ = 1, 40 do gui = activeGui() if gui then break end task.wait(0.05) end
				if gui then onStarted(me, gui) end
			end)
		end
		return s
	end)
end

hook("FlowClientMinigame", function(s, gui)
	local P = s.Network.Properties
	local n = P:Get("GridSize")
	local pr, raw = {}, P:Get("Pairs")
	for i, p in ipairs(raw) do
		local function xy(idx) return { x = (idx - 1) % n, y = (idx - 1) // n } end
		pr[i] = { a = xy(p[1]), b = xy(p[2]), color = Color3.fromHSV((i - 1) / #raw, 0.85, 1) }
	end
	local paths = solve(n, pr, true) or solve(n, pr, false)
	if paths then drawFlow(gui, n, pr, paths) else warn("highlighter: no solution found") end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------ shared overlay
local function makeOverlay(gui, board, onFrame)
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "SolutionOverlay"
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.ZIndex = 100
	overlay.Parent = gui
	local conn
	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not gui.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
		local p = board.AbsolutePosition - gui.AbsolutePosition
		overlay.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
		overlay.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(board.AbsoluteSize.X, board.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		if onFrame then onFrame(overlay.AbsoluteSize) end
	end)
	return overlay
end

local function waitBoard(gui)
	for _ = 1, 40 do
		local b = findBoard(gui.Container)
		if b then return b end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------ Connect
local CB = require(RS.Modules.Minigames.ConnectBoard)
hook("ConnectClientMinigame", function(s, gui)
	local P = s.Network.Properties
	local blobs = P:Get("Blobs")
	local layout = CB.Layout(#blobs, P:Get("Along"))
	local cb = CB.new(blobs)
	local board = waitBoard(gui)
	if not board then return end
	local lines = {}
	local overlay = makeOverlay(gui, board, function(S)
		for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
			local a, b = l.a * S, l.b * S
			local d = b - a
			l.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, 8)
			l.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) / 2, (a.Y + b.Y) / 2)
			l.f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
		end
	end)
	local function pos(i) -- side 1=top 2=right 3=bottom 4=left (guess, flip here if wrong)
		local l = layout[i]
		if l.Side == 1 then return Vector2.new(l.Along, 0)
		elseif l.Side == 2 then return Vector2.new(1, l.Along)
		elseif l.Side == 3 then return Vector2.new(l.Along, 1)
		else return Vector2.new(0, l.Along) end
	end
	for i = 1, #blobs do
		local m = cb:GetMate(i)
		if m and i < m then
			local c = typeof(blobs[i]) == "Color3" and blobs[i] or Color3.fromHSV((blobs[i] * 0.137) % 1, 0.85, 1)
			local f = Instance.new("Frame")
			f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			f.BorderSizePixel = 0
			f.BackgroundColor3 = c
			f.BackgroundTransparency = ALPHA
			f.ZIndex = 100
			f.Parent = overlay
			lines[#lines + 1] = { f = f, a = pos(i), b = pos(m) }
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------ Lock
local LB = require(RS.Modules.Minigames.LockBoard)
hook("LockClientMinigame", function(s, gui)
	local P = s.Network.Properties
	local shadow = LB.new(P:Get("Config"))
	local function sync(st)
		if typeof(st) == "table" and typeof(st.Presses) == "number" and st.Presses >= shadow.State.Presses then
			shadow:Apply(st)
		end
	end
	sync(P:Get("State"))
	P:Connect("State", sync)
	local board = waitBoard(gui)
	if not board then return end
	local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
	flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
	flash.ZIndex = 100
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame") -- target marker (0 = up, clockwise; flip if wrong)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
	dot.BackgroundTransparency = ALPHA
	dot.ZIndex = 101
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); c.Parent = dot
	local overlay = makeOverlay(gui, board, function(S)
		local a = math.rad(shadow.State.Target)
		local r = S.X * 0.4
		dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(S.X / 2 + math.sin(a) * r, S.Y / 2 - math.cos(a) * r)
		local on = shadow:IsOnTarget(shadow:AngleAt(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
		flash.BackgroundTransparency = on and ALPHA or 1
	end)
	flash.Parent = overlay
	dot.Parent = overlay
end)
print("Minigame highlighter loaded (Flow)")
